info.name: Afruheritage — Pilot API Testing (scoped)
info.description: Pilot-scoped collection: 53 requests covering the documented pilot journeys, generated from live OpenAPI (389 paths/452 ops) @ commit ee57ba5d + R1 authz fixes. NOT complete API coverage — remaining endpoints are catalogued in evidence/api_route_inventory.txt. No secrets embedded.

request.description: Registers only if {{pilot_email}} is on the Redis allowlist; 403 otherwise. Captures access_token+tenant_id.
Sends a real reset email. Reset token must be read from the mailbox — manual step.
reset_token_manual must be pasted from the email; cannot be automated.
409 if company/email exists; 403 if email not admitted. Creates tenant + portal slug.
Public status lookup; if 404, confirm tracking route name in OpenAPI.
Sends real invite email; accept token is read from the mailbox — manual.
GHS; ICUMS-style HDV benchmark; official:false; disclaimer applies.
KES; real CRSP match; needs_manual_review when no match.
Free guest check #1 of 2 per fingerprint.
3rd guest check must NOT compute: expect pilot_closed / 402 / 429 under the free pilot.
